app.errorBody: An unexpected error occurred on this screen. You can go back to the main menu and keep working.
app.referenceHint: Images with descriptions to study and review.
app.histologyHint: More than 260 tissue images with labels and descriptions, by system, by tissue type or A to Z.
app.intro: Physiology laboratory simulations. Choose a lab to get started; each one is split into activities you can move through with the tabs at the top.
app.aboutBody: This is an unofficial academic recreation of PhysioEx™. The original simulator was built in Adobe Flash, a technology discontinued in 2020; this version adapts it to current technology so it can still be used in class.
app.footer: Unofficial academic recreation of PhysioEx™. The original simulator was built in Adobe Flash, now discontinued; this version adapts it to current technology.
